verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird's own Employee Incentives and Benefits page says it advises clients from start-ups to multinationals on incentives. It also publishes factsheets on UK EMI, Company Share Option Plans, Growth Shares and Share Incentive Plans, so UK option and equity schemes are directly covered. The pack has no evidence for the other local schemes the story names, and the page describes 'advising' rather than detailing plan design. missing for 10: German VSOP/ESOP coverage, Indian ESOP coverage, detailed first-party description of the plan-design service, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm designs employee equity programs — option plans and local schemes like UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP, or Indian ESOPs — described on its own pages

citations.quote: We advise a wide range of clients from start-ups to multi-nationals on incentives issues and on the incentives aspects of corporate transactions.
